panels.title: Gallons per run by zone — true time axis (A)
panels.description: One bar per run, placed at its real start time, colored by zone. Gaps between waterings read as gaps and clustered runs render thin, because bar width is derived from how close the runs are. Unstacked — zones overlap rather than sum. Follows the dashboard time picker.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ts_start AS "time",
       'zone ' || zone AS metric,
       gallons
FROM irrigation_runs
WHERE $__timeFilter(ts_start) AND gallons IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ts_start

panels.title: Gallons per run — evenly spaced (B)
panels.description: The same runs, one bar each, evenly spaced left-to-right oldest-to-newest, colored by zone to match panel A. Even spacing means the layout no longer reflects real elapsed time, but no run is ever squeezed by a close neighbour. Follows the dashboard time picker.

targets.rawSql:
-- Farm-local labels: ts_start is timestamptz, and to_char would otherwise
-- render in the datasource session TZ (UTC), disagreeing with panel A's
-- browser-local time axis. Bay Branch is America/New_York.
-- One column per zone so the barchart colors each bar by zone (matching A);
-- each run is non-null in exactly one zone column. Zones 1-3 are the full set.
SELECT to_char(ts_start AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York', 'MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "Run",
       CASE WHEN zone = 1 THEN gallons END AS "zone 1",
       CASE WHEN zone = 2 THEN gallons END AS "zone 2",
       CASE WHEN zone = 3 THEN gallons END AS "zone 3"
FROM irrigation_runs
WHERE $__timeFilter(ts_start) AND gallons IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ts_start

panels.title: Faults in range
panels.description: Runs reporting a fault in the selected time range. Any non-zero is worth a look.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(*) AS "Faults"
FROM irrigation_runs
WHERE $__timeFilter(ts_start) AND fault IS NOT NULL

panels.title: Gallons / minute by zone
panels.description: Per-run delivery rate (gallons / duration * 60). Watch for a zone drifting low — the far-end under-delivery the EC gradient hints at.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ts_start AS "time",
       'zone ' || zone AS metric,
       gallons / NULLIF(duration_s, 0) * 60 AS gpm
FROM irrigation_runs
WHERE $__timeFilter(ts_start) AND fault IS NULL AND gallons IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ts_start

panels.title: Run history
panels.description: Most recent runs across all zones.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ts_start AS "Start",
       zone AS "Zone",
       duration_s AS "Duration (s)",
       gallons AS "Gallons",
       round((gallons / NULLIF(duration_s, 0) * 60)::numeric, 2) AS "gal/min",
       fertigated AS "Fertigated",
       fault AS "Fault"
FROM irrigation_runs
WHERE $__timeFilter(ts_start)
ORDER BY ts_start DESC
LIMIT 200

panels.title: Faults
panels.description: Runs that reported a fault. Empty is good.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ts_start AS "Start",
       zone AS "Zone",
       fault AS "Fault",
       duration_s AS "Duration (s)",
       gallons AS "Gallons"
FROM irrigation_runs
WHERE $__timeFilter(ts_start) AND fault IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ts_start DESC
LIMIT 200
